game_title: Strip And Replace – Summit Spire Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the mountaineer ahead. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the supply cache by solving code steps involving clean_text that move the mountaineer forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the supply cache first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Summit Spire'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Summit Spire.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
